findModal.title: Find Public Groups by Keyword

findModal.alertDescription: Enter keywords to query Telegram public search directly (optionally expanded by region/language), returning member counts. Matched groups are saved to Group Profiles below for further screening. Read-only: never joins or posts.
findModal.keywordsLabel: Keywords (comma or newline separated, up to 20)
findModal.regionExpandLabel: Region expansion (optional; leave empty to search raw keywords only)
findModal.expandLinked: Follow discussion groups linked to public channels (linked_chat, read-only)
findModal.expandMessages: Extract t.me / @username links from recent channel messages (graph depth=1)
findModal.enrichTme: Fetch public t.me pages for bio and member count (no login)
findModal.expandHint: When regions are selected, keywords expand across region, city, local language, Chinese, and group suffixes (up to 120 queries) for broader coverage; channels are also saved as seeds. Query yields are tracked and expansions with 0 yield for 3 consecutive runs (after 5 runs) are auto-disabled.
